-- Upsert the lesson. Education-owned columns are never touched.
INSERT INTO lessons (
    lesson_id, folder_id, grade_label, grade_sort, unit,
    lesson_number, title, lesson_url, status, machine_notes,
    seen_this_run, last_seen_at
) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8,
    CASE WHEN $9 = '' THEN 'Draft' ELSE $9 END,
    $10, true, now()
)
ON CONFLICT (lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET
    folder_id     = EXCLUDED.folder_id,
    grade_label   = EXCLUDED.grade_label,
    grade_sort    = EXCLUDED.grade_sort,
    unit          = EXCLUDED.unit,
    lesson_number = EXCLUDED.lesson_number,
    title         = EXCLUDED.title,
    lesson_url    = EXCLUDED.lesson_url,
    machine_notes = EXCLUDED.machine_notes,
    seen_this_run = true,
    last_seen_at  = now(),
    -- Never demote a human-approved Active lesson, and never auto-promote.
    status = CASE
        WHEN lessons.status = 'Active' AND EXCLUDED.status = 'Under review'
            THEN 'Under review'
        WHEN lessons.status = 'Active' THEN 'Active'
        ELSE EXCLUDED.status
    END
RETURNING lesson_id;

INSERT INTO lesson_assets (
    file_id, lesson_id, asset_type, language, title, mime_type,
    file_size, md5_checksum, view_url, download_url,
    is_public, is_primary, needs_resourcekey, owner_email, last_seen_at
)
SELECT
    x.file_id, x.lesson_id, x.asset_type, x.language, x.title, x.mime_type,
    x.file_size, NULLIF(x.md5_checksum, ''), x.view_url, x.download_url,
    x.is_public, x.is_primary, x.needs_resourcekey, NULLIF(x.owner_email, ''), now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
    file_id text, lesson_id text, asset_type text, language text,
    title text, mime_type text, file_size bigint, md5_checksum text,
    view_url text, download_url text, is_public boolean, is_primary boolean,
    needs_resourcekey boolean, owner_email text
)
WHERE x.file_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (file_id) DO UPDATE SET
    lesson_id         = EXCLUDED.lesson_id,
    asset_type        = EXCLUDED.asset_type,
    language          = EXCLUDED.language,
    title             = EXCLUDED.title,
    mime_type         = EXCLUDED.mime_type,
    file_size         = EXCLUDED.file_size,
    view_url          = EXCLUDED.view_url,
    download_url      = EXCLUDED.download_url,
    is_public         = EXCLUDED.is_public,
    is_primary        = EXCLUDED.is_primary,
    needs_resourcekey = EXCLUDED.needs_resourcekey,
    owner_email       = EXCLUDED.owner_email,
    last_seen_at      = now(),
    needs_embedding   = (lesson_assets.md5_checksum IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.md5_checksum),
    md5_checksum      = EXCLUDED.md5_checksum;

-- Retire only lessons not seen during this crawl run.
UPDATE lessons
   SET status = 'Retired',
       machine_notes = COALESCE(machine_notes,'') || ' | not found in Drive on ' || now()::date
 WHERE seen_this_run = false
   AND status <> 'Retired'
RETURNING lesson_id;

## Postgres credential

**Connection refused / 127.0.0.1:5432** means Host is empty. n8n then talks to itself, not Supabase.

1. Open the **Supabase project** → **Connect** (or Settings → Database)
2. Choose **Session pooler** (port **5432**), not Transaction pooler (6543)
3. Paste into n8n **Postgres account**:

- Host = `aws-0-<region>.pooler.supabase.com`
- User = `postgres.<project-ref>`
- Password = database password
- Database = `postgres`
- Port = `5432`
- SSL = **Require**
- **Ignore SSL Issues** = **On**

4. Click **Retest** — it must succeed — then **Save**
5. Test this workflow again

Do not leave Host blank. Do not use localhost.

---

## Google Drive HTTP Request

**List Grade Folders** is an HTTP Request node on Drive v3. n8n blocks that until:

Credentials → **Google Drive account** → **Details**
- Allow in HTTP Request node = **On**
- Allowed domains = **googleapis.com** (not all)

Save, then Test this workflow. Do not change this via API.
